title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Key Responsibilities

**1\. Admission Counselling**

* Interact with prospective parents and students and understand their educational requirements.
* Explain the school's curriculum, academic programs, facilities, activities, fee structure, policies, and admission procedures.
* Provide accurate and timely information to parents regarding admissions.
* Address parent queries professionally and follow up on unresolved concerns.

**2\. Enquiry \& Lead Management**

* Handle walk\-in, telephone, website, social media, and other admission enquiries.
* Maintain accurate records of all enquiries and follow\-ups.
* Regularly follow up with prospective parents to convert enquiries into admissions.
* Track the status of leads and maintain daily/weekly admission reports.

**3\. School Tours**

* Conduct guided campus tours for prospective parents and students.
* Highlight the school's academic facilities, infrastructure, co\-curricular activities, safety measures, and other key features.
* Ensure visitors receive a warm and professional experience.

**4\. Admission Process**

* Coordinate the complete admission process from enquiry to enrolment.
* Assist parents with application forms and required documentation.
* Coordinate entrance assessments, interviews, interactions, and other admission\-related activities.
* Coordinate with the Academic, Accounts, Administration, and other relevant departments for smooth completion of admissions.
* Ensure all admission documents are complete and properly maintained.

**5\. Parent Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain positive relationships with prospective and existing parents.
* Communicate admission\-related updates clearly and professionally.
* Handle parent concerns and escalate issues to the appropriate authority when required.

**6\. Admission Targets \& Outreach**

* Work towards assigned admission/enrolment targets.
* Support school admission campaigns, events, exhibitions, open houses, and promotional activities.
* Participate in outreach activities, school events, community engagement programs, and other admission\-generation initiatives.
* Identify potential sources for generating new admission enquiries.

**7\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain daily enquiry and admission records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly admission reports.
* Maintain follow\-up trackers and conversion reports.
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong counselling and interpersonal skills.
* Good convincing and relationship\-building abilities.
* Customer\-service orientation.
* Ability to handle parents professionally and patiently.
* Good follow\-up and lead\-conversion skills.
* Basic computer knowledge, including MS Office and CRM/admission software.
* Strong organisational and documentation skills.
* Ability to work towards targets and deadlines.
* Professional presentation and positive attitude.

Pay: ₹11,194\.76 \- ₹35,681\.25 per month

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

title: ServiceNow PPM Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a ServiceNow SPM, PPM, CWM professional with 2–4 years of experience to support the implementation, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management, Project Portfolio Management, and Collaborative Work Management capabilities. The candidate should have hands\-on exposure to demand management, project management, portfolio planning, resource management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination within the ServiceNow platform.


Key Responsibilities

* Support configuration and administration of ServiceNow SPM, PPM, and CWM capabilities \- Strategic Portfolio Management, Project Portfolio Management, Collaborative Work Management, including the Intake, Demand, and Capacity management processes, workflows, reporting, and other related functionalities.
* Assist in gathering business requirements from stakeholders and translating them into functional ServiceNow configurations.
* Configure forms, fields, workflows, approvals, notifications, dashboards, and reports based on business needs.
* Support project intake, demand assessment, project tracking, status reporting, resource planning, and portfolio visibility processes.
* Collaborate with functional teams, business users, developers, and platform administrators to deliver scalable ServiceNow solutions.
* Participate in testing activities, including test case preparation, user acceptance testing support, defect tracking, and validation of fixes.
* Maintain documentation for requirements, configurations, process flows, user guides, and support procedures.
* Provide day\-to\-day support for ServiceNow PPM/SPM users, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and training support.
* Ensure configurations follow ServiceNow best practices, platform governance standards, and maintainability guidelines.

Required Skills and Experience

* 2–4 years of overall experience working with ServiceNow, preferably with exposure to SPM, PPM, CWM related portfolio, project, and capacity planning and management capabilities.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow platform basics, including tables, forms, lists, workflows, roles, groups, notifications, and reports.
* Working knowledge of PPM/SPM concepts such as demand intake, project lifecycle, portfolio planning, resource planning, financial tracking, and status reporting.
* Basic understanding of Agile, Scrum, waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into clear functional specifications or configuration tasks.
* Experience supporting dashboards, reports, performance analytics, or portfolio\-level visibility is preferred.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.

Qualification Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent professional experience in ServiceNow administration, project management systems, or enterprise workflow platforms may be considered.
* Understanding of IT service management, project portfolio management, and enterprise delivery governance is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Good to have Certifications or Training

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management / Project Portfolio Management training.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS\-SPM) certification is strongly preferred; candidates who have completed the required learning path or are actively pursuing certification may also be considered.
* Training in ServiceNow SPM Fundamentals and ServiceNow SPM Implementation is preferred.
* Agile/Scrum certification or training, such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI\-ACP, or SAFe, is an added advantage.
* Project management certification or training, such as PMI \- Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), is an added advantage.

Preferred Capabilities

* Exposure to ServiceNow integrations, Flow Designer, basic scripting, or data imports.
* Experience working with project managers, PMO teams, portfolio managers, or delivery governance teams.
* Knowledge of reporting metrics such as project health, demand pipeline, portfolio performance, resource utilization, and milestone tracking.
* Ability to support process improvement initiatives and adoption of standardized project and portfolio management practices.

Good to Have / Rare Skills

* Exposure to ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Advanced Work Assignment, or Predictive Intelligence for portfolio and demand insights.
* Basic knowledge of ServiceNow IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, MID Server concepts, or external system integrations with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Microsoft Project.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow App Engine Studio, custom scoped applications, UI Builder, Workspace configuration, or Now Experience components.
* Understanding of portfolio financial planning, benefit realization tracking, scenario planning, or strategic roadmap management within ServiceNow SPM.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled capabilities in ServiceNow, including Now Assist, automation recommendations, or AI\-driven work prioritization.

The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. * Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring timely escalation where required.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.


2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management  

* Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
* Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
* Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.

title: Front Desk Executive
description:
**Academy Front Desk Administrator** 

**About Muzigal**

Muzigal was founded in the year 2020 by Dr. Lakshminarayana Yeluri, a serial Entrepreneur and Musician, with a vision to make high\-quality music education accessible and affordable by connecting huge untapped music teaching talent with aspiring learners through its app and offline academies. Within 24 months of its inception, Muzigal has served over 24,000 students and more than 400 teachers. Muzigal is the first\-ever organised player revolutionising the music education space globally. Muzigal has emerged as a dominant player in the last 18 months and has become the largest destination for music teachers and students.

Muzigal offers beginners to intermediate level music classes across Indian and Western music genres for all age groups through its proprietary curriculum delivered by qualified music teachers. Muzigal currently operates several offline academies across India and is expanding its footprint rapidly to become a household name for music learning in India and globally. The brand plans to expand to 100\+ academies across India within the next 18 months.

**Role Overview**

The Counsellor \& Admin at Muzigal Academy is a full\-time and multi\-functional position. The incumbent reports to the Academy Owner. S/he plays a pivotal role in managing sales \& marketing activities at the front desk that include making calls and responding to queries, ensuring steady stream of walkins, maintaining CRM Hygiene, undertaking walk\-in management tasks \- conduct academy tour, scheduling demo with Faculty, communicating with the walkin to ensure enrollment. In the Admin role the incumbent is required to manage day to day tasks of running facilities such as \- ensure opening and closing routines as per company SOP, maintain and manage inventory \- Forms, Info Leaflets and Brochures, Instruments \& Accessories, Books, , ensure display of instruments and follow the SOPS and guidelines prescribed by the Company.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensuring the Academy opens and closes as per timings and associated opening and closing routines strictly implemented such \- cleanliness,
* Keeping the frontdesk walkin ready to efficiently manage the counselling and enrollment processes \- Forms, Brochures,Desktop PoS and so on,
* Establishing rapport with the walkins and obtaining their relevant information to help in the right choice of course.
* Counselling the prospects on making the right choice of music learning through the various Muzigal information collaterals.
* Introduce the learning structures through Muzigal Preparatory Curriculum Framework and explain the learning progression Learn\> Play \> Inspire
* Ensuring Facility is managed efficiently as per company protocol
* Running daily checklist \- Day opening/ Closing,
* Ensuring inventory levels of stationary, pantry and other day to day supplies and services are satisfactorily maintained. Reordering if necessary.
* Maintain and manage vendor list for purchases, Payments, replacements and maintenance of facility.
* Ensure all Academy checklists are verified – cleaning and ambiance checklist , sterilisation checklist, toilet checklist, etc.
* Ensure that the Academy is running smoothly at all times
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective students and parents to provide information about the academy's courses and offerings.
* Achieve and exceed weekly/monthly sales targets through effective telephonic communication and follow\-up.
* Implement sales strategies to convert leads into enrollments.
* Provide regular reports on tele calling and sales activities.
* Keeping the CRM updated for the Muzigal academy
* Be willing to work extra hours and on holidays if required.
* Any other duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

* High School / Graduate
* Strong communication and people skills
* Knowledge of office management and basic book\-keeping
* Excellent knowledge of MS Office applications (especially Excel and Word)
* Good organisational and multitasking abilities
* Problem\-solving skills
* Eye for detail
* Customer service orientation
* Working knowledge of Regional/Local Language, English \& Hindi

* Minimum of one year’s experience in a similar position.
* Preference will be given to candidates with previous experience in tele calling

**Salary**

* 1\.8L\-2\.4L CTC based on qualifications, experience and interview

The Systems Administrator is responsible for maintaining the availability, security, and performance of Windows and Linux systems in both production and non\-production environments. This role focuses on troubleshooting, resolving system performance and availability issues, and ensuring a reliable and secure environment. The Systems Administrator also assists in automating common tasks to improve operational efficiency. * Experience with managing and troubleshooting Windows and Linux servers.
* Understanding of server hardware components and infrastructure service delivery.

* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to handle tasks under pressure.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team environment.
* Fluent speaking, reading, and writing in English

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Server\+ or similar.

description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.

title: Lead IAM Analyst
description:
**Role Overview:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and self\-driven IAM Automation and Governance Specialist to enhance and automate our identity and access management (IAM) practices. The role will be primarily focused on integrating Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) with UKG (HRIS) systems, ensuring secure identity lifecycle management aligned with Zero Trust, least privilege, and regulatory compliance (HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS).


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Identity \& Access Management:**


* Expert\-level experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)


* Hands\-on with Entitlement Management: Access Packages, Catalogs


* Proficient in Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Access Reviews, Conditional Access


* Automate Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) workflows and user lifecycle events


* Identify and remediate orphaned accounts and over\-permissioned users


* Strong understanding of RBAC and ABAC access control models.


**Scripting \& Automation:**


* Strong proficiency in PowerShell (Graph API, AzureAD, MSOnline, Az modules)


* Ability to automate:


* IAM data exports (e.g., PIM assignments, access packages)


* Sign\-in \& activity log queries


* Provisioning/Deprovisioning tasks


* Knowledge of modular and maintainable scripting best practices


**Security \& Compliance:**


* Understanding of frameworks: NIST 800\-53, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS


* Ability to map IAM controls to compliance framework


* Experience supporting audits through evidence gathering and documentation


**Azure Cloud \& Microsoft Ecosystem:**


* Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, and RBAC


* Experience with Intune, Defender for Endpoint, and Company Portal


* Troubleshoot Conditional Access and authentication issues


* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Security \& Compliance Center


**Documentation \& Process Management:**


* Develop SOPs, process flows, and policy documents


* Create and maintain IAM maturity models and strategic roadmaps


* Prepare documentation to support regulatory audits


**Key Competencies:**


* Process Automation: Streamline IAM operations through scripting and workflows


* Security Focus: Deep understanding of IAM security challenges and solutions


* Analytical Thinking: Ability to evaluate and improve access control models


* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Bridge gaps between technical and business functions


* Regulatory Awareness: Strong foundation in data protection, access control standards, and compliance regulations


**Soft Skills:**


* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently


* Strong attention to detail with a security\-first mindset


* Excellent communication skills for technical and non\-technical stakeholders


* Strong collaboration across HR, IT, Security, and DevOps teams


**Education \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's in computer science, Information Security, or related field


* 8–10 years of experience in IAM or IT Security


* Experience integrating Microsoft Entra ID with HRIS platforms (preferably UKG)


* Background in IAM governance and automation in compliance\-heavy environments


**Preferred Certifications:**


* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator


* CISSP / CISM (or equivalent)


* Azure Security Engineer Associate
